persons.name: Hemantamalla
persons.evidence: hemanta mallo alikhat || || śrī śrī hemantamallena thamacosyaṃ sidhayakā juroṃ

date.as_written: śāke veda śaśāṃka kuṃjaramite nepālike mādhave, saptamyāṃ śanivāsare suvidite śukle hipuṣpe / samvat 814 vaiśākhaśudi 7

purpose: tuṣṭyai rāghavapuṃgavasya / vudhamude / thamacosyaṃ (written by himself)
notes: The chronogram 'veda śaśāṃka kuṃjara' gives 814 Nepāla Saṃvat, confirmed by 'samvat 814'. The Newari phrase 'thamacosyaṃ sidhayakā juroṃ' indicates that Hemantamalla completed copying the manuscript himself.
